items.title: 3.3.2 Valence shell electron pair repulsion model (VSEPR) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.3.2, printed pages 52-58, with Quick Checks 3.5 and 3.6.

blocks.text: VSEPR model molecules ki shape (shakal) is buniyad par batata hai ke central (beech wale) atom ke gird kitne electron pairs hain. Yeh model Sidgwick aur Powell ne 1940 mein pesh kiya. Is ka basic idea yeh hai ke molecule woh shape leta hai jis mein central atom ke valence electrons ke beech repulsion (dhakka, ek doosre ko door karna) sab se kam ho. Repulsion kam karne ke liye electron pairs ek doosre se jitna ho sake door chale jate hain. Electron pairs ka yehi arrangement (tarteeb) molecule ki geometry decide karta hai.
Postulates (buniyadi baatein):

items: Lone pairs (jo bond mein nahi) aur bond pairs dono molecule ki geometry decide karte hain.
Electron pairs central atom ke gird is tarah phailte hain ke ek doosre se zyada se zyada door rahein aur repulsion se bachein.

Lone pair ke electrons bond pair se zyada jagah lete hain. Is liye lone pairs bond pairs ko zyada dhakelte hain aur unhen qareeb daba dete hain. Repulsion ki strength is order mein kam hoti hai: lone pair-lone pair (lp-lp) > lone pair-bond pair (lp-bp) > bond pair-bond pair (bp-bp).
Double bond ke do pairs aur triple bond ke teen pairs mein charge density zyada hoti hai, lekin unhen ek hi pair gina jata hai.
Agar central atom ke saath bohat electronegative atoms hon to bond pairs ka aapas ka repulsion kam ho jata hai, lekin lone pair ka repulsion zyada ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do khaakon ki patti. Baen: atom X aur atom H, beech mein lamba patla electron badal (bond pair). Daen: atom X, ek taraf chaura gol electron badal (lone pair), jo bond pair ke badal se saaf mota hai.
blocks.caption: Do nuclei mein share hone wala electron pair ek nucleus se bandhe lone pair se kam jagah leta hai (kitab mein postulates ke oopar chhapi strip ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bond pair ka electron cloud do nuclei (X aur H) ke beech khincha hua aur patla hai, kyun ke dono nuclei use pakarte hain. Lone pair sirf ek nucleus (X) se bandha hai, is liye phail kar zyada jagah leta hai. Isi wajah se lone pair bond pairs ko zyada dhakelta hai aur bond angles chhote ho jate hain.
Molecules ki shape ka andaza

Is model ko samjhane ke liye central atom ko ‘A’ aur us ke gird electron pairs ko ‘B’ kaha jata hai. Central atom ki valency ke mutabiq us ke gird electron pairs ki tadaad alag ho sakti hai, is liye AB₂, AB₃, AB₄ waghaira type ke molecules bante hain. Electron pair geometry ‘A’ ke gird kul electron pairs se decide hoti hai. Lekin molecule ki asal shape sirf atoms se dekhi jati hai, lone pairs ko chhor kar. Table 3.1 alag bond pairs aur lone pairs wale molecules ki shapes dikhata hai.

blocks.caption: Table 3.1: Covalent compounds ki geometry aur shape (sahi kiya hua)
header: No. of electron pairs around central atom

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Table 3.1 mein I₃⁻ ko PCl₅ ke saath 5 electron pairs aur 0 lone pair wali row mein likha hai. Lekin kitab khud aage (AB₅ type mein) kehti hai ke I₃⁻ ke central iodine par 2 bond pairs aur 3 lone pairs hain. Is liye I₃⁻ ki electron pair geometry trigonal bipyramidal hai magar shape linear (180°). Upar table mein I₃⁻ ki alag row (5 pairs, 3 lone pairs) di gayi hai.
Shape maloom karne ke steps
Molecule ki shape ka andaza in steps se lagaya jata hai.

items: Sab se kam electronegative atom, ya woh element jis ke atoms sab se kam hon, aksar central atom hota hai. Maslan CCl₄ mein carbon central atom hai.
Central atom ke gird kul electron pairs ginein (bond pairs aur lone pairs dono). Maslan CCl₄ mein C ke gird 4 bond pairs hain aur koi lone pair nahi.
Kul electron pairs se electron pair geometry maloom hoti hai (upar wale table se). Maslan CCl₄ ke chaar pairs hain, is liye geometry tetrahedral hai.
Aakhir mein lone pairs (agar hon) ko chhor kar molecule ki asal shape batayein.

blocks.alt: CCl4 ka electron-dot structure. Ek circle (daira), beech mein C. Circle par oopar, neeche, baen aur daen ek cross (carbon ka electron). Har cross ke bahar ek dot (chlorine ka electron), aur us ke bahar Cl. Yani chaar Cl atoms mein se har ek carbon ke saath ek pair (dot aur cross) share karta hai: C par chaar bond pairs, koi lone pair nahi.
blocks.caption: CCl₄ ka electron-dot structure: C ke gird chaar bond pairs, koi lone pair nahi (kitab mein steps ke saath, caption ke baghair).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cross (×) carbon ke electrons hain aur dot (•) chlorine ke. Har Cl aur C ke beech ek dot aur ek cross mil kar ek bond pair banate hain. C ke gird kul chaar pairs hain, sab bond pairs, koi lone pair nahi. Is liye CCl₄ ki geometry aur shape dono tetrahedral hain.
AB₂ type molecules (linear geometry)

In molecules mein central atom ke gird do electron pairs 180° par hote hain taake repulsion kam ho. Is tarah linear (seedhi) geometry banti hai (Figure 3.9). BeCl₂ AB₂ type hai: Be central atom hai, us ke gird do bond pairs hain aur koi lone pair nahi.

blocks.alt: Baen: Cl-Be-Cl seedhi lakeer mein, Be ke oopar muRa dohra arrow (teer), 180 degrees likha. Daen: ball-and-stick model, do bari neeli Cl gendein chhoti laal Be gend ke zariye seedh mein juri.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.9: BeCl2 molecule ki seedhi (linear) shape (kitab ki Figure 3.9 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: AB₃ type (trigonal planar geometry)

AB₃ type molecules mein central atom ke gird teen electron pairs hote hain jo ek doosre se zyada se zyada door, 120° par, phailte hain aur trigonal geometry banti hai. Maslan BF₃ trigonal planar (ek flat plane par triangle) hai aur har F–B–F angle 120° hai (Figure 3.10). Group 3 (III-A) ke hydrides, AlH₃, GaH₃, BH₃ waghaira, ki geometry bhi aisi hi hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: beech mein B, teen F atoms se jura, ek oopar aur do neeche, do F atoms ke beech muRa dohra arrow, 120 degrees. Daen: ball model, bari laal B gend aur triangle ke corners par teen chhoti neeli gendein.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.10: BF3 ek AB3 system hai jis ki trigonal planar (flat triangle jaisi) geometry hai (kitab ki Figure 3.10 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: SnCl₂ mein Sn ke bahar wale shell mein 4 electrons hain. Woh do Cl atoms ke saath do bonds banata hai aur baqi do electrons lone pair ban kar rehte hain (kitab 'Figure 3.11' kehti hai, magar woh figure chhapi nahi). Triangle ka ek corner yeh lone pair le leta hai, is liye vapour (bhaap) state mein electron pair geometry distorted (bigri hui) trigonal hai. SnCl₂ ki asal shape v-shaped hai aur lone pair ki wajah se bond angle 120° se kam hai.
AB₃ type, multiple bonds ke saath

SO₃ mein teenon jagahon par S=O bonds hain. SO₃ bilkul trigonal hai aur har angle 120° hai. Doosri taraf SO₂ mein triangle ka ek corner lone pair ne liya hai aur baqi do corners par ek ek double bond (S=O) hai. Is liye SO₂ bhi SnCl₂ ki tarah mura hua (angular, v-shaped) hai (Fig 3.12).

blocks.alt: Baen: SO3, beech mein S aur triangle ke corners par O atoms se teen S=O double bonds, ek angle 120 degrees. Daen: SO2, S ke oopar do laal nuqton wala lone pair lobe aur neeche do S=O bonds; O-S-O angle 'Less than 120 degrees' likha.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.12: Multiple bonds wale SO2 aur SO3 ki shapes (kitab ki Figure 3.12 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: AB₄ type (tetrahedral geometry)

Is type ke molecules mein chaar electron pairs ke charge clouds ek doosre se zyada se zyada door ja kar regular tetrahedron ki shape banate hain. Har bond angle 109.5° hota hai. Maslan methane mein carbon ke chaar valence electrons har ek hydrogen atom ke akele electron ke saath pair banate hain. Chaar bond pairs center se tetrahedron ke chaar corners ki taraf hain, aur har corner par ek hydrogen nucleus hai (Fig 3.13). Yeh arrangement non-planar (ek flat plane par nahi) hai. Har H–C–H angle bilkul 109.5° hai. SiH₄, GeH₄ aur CCl₄ ki shape bhi yehi hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: methane ka ball-and-stick model, kaali C gend neele khaake wale tetrahedron ke corners par chaar halki neeli H gendon se juri. Daen: CH4 ki lakeeri tasveer, C chaar H atoms se jura, H atoms dashed lakeeron se tetrahedron banate hain, H-C-H angle 109.5 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.13: CH4 molecule ki regular tetrahedral shape (kitab ki Figure 3.13 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Extend your knowledge
blocks.text: Tetrahedron ke chaar corners, chaar faces (chehre), chhe edges (kinare) aur chhe bond angles hote hain. Ideal (misali) tetrahedron mein har bond angle 109.5° hota hai.

Ammonia (NH₃) mein nitrogen ke saath teen atoms jure hain aur ek lone pair hai. Lone pair ki wajah se ideal angle 109.5° kam ho kar 107° reh jata hai (Figure 3.14). Is liye ammonia tetrahedral ke bajaye trigonal pyramidal shape leta hai. Agar NH₃ ke hydrogen ki jagah F ya Cl jaise electronegative atoms aa jayein to angle aur kam ho jata hai. Maslan NF₃ mein teen bohat electronegative F atoms N se jure hain aur angle 102.5° tak dab jata hai. Pehli wajah: N–F bond bohat polar hai, is liye N atom lone pair ko apne nucleus ke qareeb khinch leta hai, aur yeh lone pair bonding electrons ko zyada dhakelta hai. Doosri wajah: bond pairs (N–F bonds) N ke bajaye F atoms ke qareeb hain; un ke beech fasla barh jata hai, repulsion kamzor hota hai aur bonds qareeb a jate hain.

blocks.alt: NH3 ki teen tasweerein. Baen: tetrahedron, beech mein N, teen corners par H gendein aur oopar wale kone par do nuqton wala lone pair lobe. Beech: pyramid shape ka ball model, N teen H atoms ke oopar. Daen: wedge-aur-dash tasveer, N aur teen H, H atoms dashed lakeeron se jure, aur arrow H-N-H angle ki taraf, 107 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.14: NH3 molecule ki distorted (bigri hui) geometry aur pyramidal shape (kitab ki Figure 3.14 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Experiments batate hain ke pani (H₂O) ka molecule mura hua (angular, v-shaped) hai, halanke central atom ke gird chaar electron pairs hain. Tetrahedron ke do corners par do lone pairs hain aur baqi do par bond pairs. Lone pairs ka repulsion zyada hai, is liye bond angle kam ho kar 104.5° reh jata hai (Fig 3.15).

blocks.alt: Baen, 'Tetrahedral geometry including lone pairs' likha: tetrahedron mein laal O gend, neeche ke do corners par H gendein aur do lone pair lobes, har ek mein do nuqte, oopar aur neeche. Daen, 'Angular shape of water molecule excluding lone pairs' likha: H2O ka mura hua ball model aur H-O-H lakeeri tasveer, angle 104.5 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.15: Pani ke molecule ke do lone pairs hain aur woh suppressed (dabe hue) bond angle ke saath v-shaped hai (kitab ki Figure 3.15 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani mein chaar electron pairs hain: do bond pairs aur do lone pairs, jo tetrahedron ke corners par hain (geometry). Shape sirf atoms se dekhi jati hai, lone pairs ko chhor kar, is liye molecule mura hua (angular) hai. Do lone pairs ka zyada repulsion angle ko 109.5° se 104.5° tak daba deta hai.

VSEPR model ions ki shape bhi samjhata hai. Hydronium ion [H₃O]⁺ tab banta hai jab pani ka molecule ek proton pakar leta hai. Hydronium ion AB₄ type hai jis par ek lone pair hai, is liye ammonia ki tarah trigonal pyramidal hai. Amide ion [NH₂]⁻ bhi AB₄ type hai: us ke gird do lone pairs aur do bond pairs hain. Is ki geometry tetrahedral hai, lekin shape pani ki tarah bent (mudi hui, v-shape) hai (Figure 3.16).

blocks.alt: Chaar hisse. 'Hydronium ion': laal lone pair electrons wala pani ka molecule, lone pair se H+ ki taraf muRa arrow, aur neeche H3O+ ki Lewis structure, ek lone pair aur + charge. 'Tetrahedral electron pair geometry': tetrahedron mein O, teen H gendein aur oopar lone pair lobe. 'Trigonal pyramidal shape': O gend teen H gendon ke oopar. 'V-shaped amide ion': N, do hare lone pair lobes aur H se do bonds 104.1 degrees par, chakor brackets mein, minus charge.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.16: Hydronium (H3O+) aur amide (NH2-) ions ki shapes (kitab ki Figure 3.16 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Quick Check 3.5

blocks.prompt: a) SiH₄, H₂Se aur PH₃ mein bond pairs aur lone pairs ginein.
blocks.explanation: SiH₄: 4 bond pairs, 0 lone pair. H₂Se: 2 bond pairs, 2 lone pairs. PH₃: 3 bond pairs, 1 lone pair.

blocks.prompt: b) SiH₄, H₂Se aur PH₃ ki shapes aur angles batayein.
blocks.explanation: SiH₄: tetrahedral, 109.5°. PH₃: trigonal pyramidal, angle 109.5° se kam (asal mein taqreeban 93°). H₂Se: angular (v-shaped), angle 109.5° se kaafi kam (taqreeban 91°).

blocks.prompt: c) H₂S ka bond angle H₂O se kaise alag hoga?
blocks.explanation: Dono v-shaped hain, lekin H₂S ka angle (taqreeban 92°) H₂O (104.5°) se chhota hai. Sulfur bara atom hai aur kam electronegative hai, is liye bond pairs us ke qareeb kam jama hote hain aur lone pairs unhen zyada qareeb daba dete hain.

blocks.text: AB₅ type (trigonal bipyramid geometry)

AB₅ type molecules mein paanch electron pairs ka repulsion tab kam hota hai jab woh trigonal bipyramid ke corners par barabar phail jayein. Trigonal bipyramid mein teen jagahein ek flat triangle ke corners par hain, aur baqi do us plane ke upar aur neeche ek seedhi line (axis) par. PCl₅ ki shape yehi hai (Figure 3.17). Triangle ke andar angle 120° hain aur axial (upar/neeche wale) atom aur triangle wale atom ke beech 90°.

blocks.alt: PCl5 ki teen tasweerein. Baen: Lewis structure, P paanch Cl atoms se jura, har Cl par teen lone pairs. Beech: dotted trigonal bipyramid ke andar laal P gend ke gird paanch surmai electron pair lobes. Daen: ball-and-stick model, laal P gend aur paanch hari Cl gendein, do khare axis par aur teen beech mein gird.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.17: PCl5 molecule ki Lewis structure aur shape (kitab ki Figure 3.17 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: AB₃ aur AB₄ ki tarah AB₅ mein bhi lone pairs shape aur angles badal dete hain, aur yahan tabdeeli aur bhi bari hai. Tri-iodide ion [I₃]⁻ linear hai, halanke yeh AB₅ system hai. Is ion mein central atom iodine hai. Us ke gird paanch electron pairs hain: do bond pairs aur teen lone pairs. Is liye yeh teen lone pairs wala AB₅ type hai aur us ki geometry trigonal bipyramidal hai. Teenon lone pairs triangle ke corners par hain aur do iodine atoms upar aur neeche ki apices (chotiyon) par. Lone pairs ko chhor kar tri-iodide ion ki asal shape linear hai aur iodine atoms 180° par sab se door hain (Figure 3.18).

blocks.alt: Beech mein laal iodine gend, khari chhaRi par us ke bilkul oopar aur neeche do iodine gendein, aur beech mein teen surmai lone pair lobes, ek baen aur do daen. Baen taraf aadhe daire ki qaus oopar aur neeche ke iodine atoms ko milati hai, 180 degrees likha.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.18: Tri-iodide ion ([I3]-) ki shape (kitab ki Figure 3.18 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: AB₆ type molecules (octahedral geometry)

AB₆ type molecules mein central atom ke gird 6 electron pairs hote hain. In ka repulsion octahedral geometry se kam hota hai. Is geometry mein chaar electron pairs ek flat square (murabba) ke corners par hain aur baqi do square ke upar aur neeche ek axis par. Is geometry mein sab A–B–A angles 90° hain. SF₆ ki Lewis structure Figure 3.19 mein hai; yeh AB₆ type molecule hai.

blocks.alt: SF6 ki teen tasweerein. Baen: Lewis structure, S chhe F atoms se jura, har F par teen lone pairs. Beech: octahedral ball-and-stick model, peeli S gend chhe hari F gendon se juri, octahedron ke dashed kinare. Daen: wedge-aur-dash tasveer, S ke oopar aur neeche F, do hashed bonds peeche aur do wedge bonds aage, do angle 90 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.19: SF6 ki Lewis structure aur octahedral shape, har angle 90 degrees (kitab ki Figure 3.19 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: XeF₄ AB₆ type molecule hai jis mein chaar bond pairs aur do lone pairs hain. Do lone pairs ek doosre se sab se door, 180° par, rehte hain. Lone pairs ko chhor kar XeF₄ ki asal shape square planar hai aur sab F–Xe–F angles 90° hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne XeF₄ ke angles 'F-P-F' likhe hain. XeF₄ mein phosphorus (P) nahi hai; sahi F–Xe–F angles hain, har ek 90°.

blocks.alt: XeF4 ki teen tasweerein. Baen: Lewis structure, Xe par do lone pairs aur chaar F atoms se jura, har F par teen lone pairs. Beech: narangi Xe gend ke gird chaar hari F gendein aur do neele lone pair lobes oopar aur neeche, qaus ke saath 'lone pair is farthest at 180 degrees' likha. Daen: square planar ball model, chaar F atoms ke dashed murabbe ke beech Xe, ek angle 90 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.20: XeF4 ki Lewis structure aur square planar shape (kitab ki Figure 3.20 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: XeF₄ mein Xe ke gird chhe pairs hain: chaar bond pairs aur do lone pairs. Do lone pairs ek doosre se sab se door, 180° par, yani upar aur neeche rehte hain. Chaar F atoms beech ke flat square mein reh jate hain, is liye shape square planar hai aur har F–Xe–F angle 90° hai.
Quick Check 3.6

blocks.prompt: IF₃ aur IF₅ ki Lewis structures banayein aur VSEPR se un ki geometry batayein.
blocks.explanation: IF₃: iodine ke gird 3 bond pairs aur 2 lone pairs, kul 5 pairs; electron pair geometry trigonal bipyramidal, lone pairs triangle mein, is liye shape T-shaped. IF₅: 5 bond pairs aur 1 lone pair, kul 6 pairs; geometry octahedral, shape square pyramidal.

answer_figure.alt: Baayen IF₃ ki Lewis structure: I ke saath teen F single bonds (oopar, neeche, daayen) aur I par do lone pairs; har F par teen lone pairs. Daayen shape: do lone pair lobes baayen taraf equatorial jagah par, teen F ek T banate hain: T-shaped. Neeche: Baayen IF₅ ki Lewis structure: I ke saath paanch F single bonds aur I par ek lone pair; har F par teen lone pairs. Daayen shape: ek F oopar, chaar F ek square base mein, aur lone pair ka lobe neeche: square pyramidal.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: IF₃ ki Lewis structure aur VSEPR shape (T-shaped); neeche: IF₅ ki Lewis structure aur VSEPR shape (square pyramidal)
answer_figure.long_description:
Iodine ke gird 3 bond pairs aur 2 lone pairs, kul 5 pairs: electron pairs ki tarteeb trigonal bipyramidal. Dono lone pairs equatorial (tikon wali) jagah lete hain, is liye atoms ki shape T jaisi hai: do F oopar neeche (axial) aur ek F saamne (equatorial).

Neeche: Iodine ke gird 5 bond pairs aur 1 lone pair, kul 6 pairs: electron pairs ki tarteeb octahedral. Ek corner lone pair le leta hai, is liye paanch F atoms square pyramid banate hain: chaar F square base mein, ek F oopar, aur lone pair base ke neeche.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: VSEPR (Sidgwick aur Powell, 1940): central atom ke gird electron pairs ek doosre se zyada se zyada door rehte hain; lone pairs geometry mein gine jate hain, shape mein nahi, aur sab se zyada dhakelte hain (lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp); multiple bond ek pair gina jata hai.

AB₂ linear 180°; AB₃ trigonal 120° (ek lone pair: v-shaped, SnCl₂, SO₂); AB₄ tetrahedral 109.5° (NH₃ 107°, NF₃ 102.5°, H₂O 104.5°; H₃O⁺ pyramidal, NH₂⁻ bent); AB₅ trigonal bipyramidal 120° aur 90° (I₃⁻ teen lone pairs ke saath linear); AB₆ octahedral 90° (XeF₄ do lone pairs ke saath square planar).
